notes.title: The wait is finally over, Free the Bees on April 7th!
notes.content: Get ready to unleash a brand-new way to break bricks—this time with hexagons, honey, chains, and over-the-top projectiles! Blast through four styled worlds, save the Bees from their hex prisons, and hang out with them in the sanctuary. Rise through the ranks an collect all 42 Bee Ranger skill patches to claim your place as the hive’s monarch.  When you think you cant climb any higher, craft your own custom levels to keep the buzz going.  Mark your calendar, Wishlist now, and let’s free some Bees!

notes.title: Freeing the Bees in Free-Bees!
notes.content:
Free-Bees a unique take on the classic brick-breaker, with players breaking hexagons and chaining projectiles together in a unique blend of controlled arcade chaos. The game has a full level editor, allowing players to build their levels and share them on the workshop.  

Join us for a live stream demo of the playing through the game!
